verdict.rationale: A built-in query-insights view is a fair axis for a database product like ClickHouse, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a view showing slow queries, index recommendations, or performance metrics. The ClickStack AI notebook waitlist item covers querying a user's own logs, traces, and metrics. It is not a database query-insights view, and the evidence presents it only as a waitlist for an unreleased feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view
